name: Chem-User level 3
summary: Chem-User; Once per long rest, inject combat chems as a bonus action. Gain +10 ft speed and advantage on Strength and Dexterity checks for 1 minute. Afterwards, make a Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.
